description: An unofficial private companion for using Firecrawl's web-data workflows and contributing to the Firecrawl source repository.

capabilities: Find and retrieve web sources with traceable URLs
Extract structured data with explicit schemas
Operate browser sessions with verification and safety checks
Parse documents and manage requested website monitors
Follow repository-specific development and test instructions
defaultPrompt: Use Firecrawl to research this topic and cite the source URLs.
Extract these fields from the supplied pages into a structured table.
Help me make a safe, test-backed contribution to the Firecrawl repository.
interface.longDescription: An unofficial private toolkit for using Firecrawl effectively: search the web, scrape pages, map and crawl bounded site sections, extract structured data, operate browser sessions, parse documents, and monitor website changes. It also includes source-grounded guidance for contributing to the public Firecrawl repository. The toolkit uses the existing Firecrawl app when available; it does not bundle or deploy Firecrawl's server runtime. Live operations may require Firecrawl account access and consume service credits.

name: firecrawl-toolkit
